topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I can't believe what I've just found out. My friend, who I've known for years, has been telling everyone they're a high-flying consultant, but it turns out their job is something totally different. I stumbled upon this information accidentally, and I'm processing it. I never thought they'd fabricate something so significant. I guess I'm left wondering how much of anything they say is truly genuine. I need to think about this a lot before I decide what to do next.
